tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by four different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Confirmed by CNBC: Anthropic expands the Claude Startups program, offering 45K credits and free artificial intelligence tools to founders and fast-growing companies.
Confirmed by Newsweek: McDonald's faces a lawsuit after allegedly using an artificial intelligence pricing system to coordinate menu prices across U.S. restaurants.
Confirmed by The Guardian: OpenAI has withdrawn an artificial intelligence model over safety failures, citing a lack of rigorous risk analysis.
Still open, per The Guardian: The film Artificial satirizes artificial intelligence leaders, portraying the technology's ethical risks and societal impacts.
Still open, per citybiz: OpenAI seeks 30 billion dollars at a 1.4 trillion dollar valuation, with BlackRock and UAE funds among potential investors.
